onnx.representation: controlled, derived, unquantized FP five-component ONNX; not called original weights

calls.note: Frame and flow counts derive from 149760 samples / 1920 samples per latent frame and num_steps=1. The C API does not expose separate internal text/encoder/decoder call timers.

onnx.memory_limit: VmHWM is cumulative process-lifetime high-water and includes mapped runtime/models, caches, working buffers and audio; it is not isolated model memory.
onnx.thermal_limit: ONNX ran first. No laboratory thermal stabilization or fixed-frequency control was used; sequential runs inherit DVFS/thermal state.

executorch.blocker: Strict torch.export cannot guard the data-dependent Eq(u9,0) expression in scaled_dot_product_attention with explicit recurrent/streaming state. Both blocked components are essential to complete TTS. Export-safe cache/attention replacement would be broad model surgery requiring a separate equivalence campaign.
